name: git-status
description: A read-only git dashboard: branch, remote and status in a row above the prompt (or the status line), and /git-status for every branch with its history, tags and worktrees

showBranch.title: Show branch
showBranch.description: Show the checked-out branch in the summary.

showRemote.title: Show remote
showRemote.description: Show the upstream branch, commits to push and pull, and when the repo was last fetched.

showStatus.title: Show status
showStatus.description: Show staged, changed, untracked and conflicted files, an operation in progress, and stashes.

placement.title: Where the summary shows
placement.description: above-prompt: a row above the prompt with a + button that opens the pane (one row, shared with other mods: only one can draw it). status-line: a line under the prompt that sits beside other mods' lines, with the + button at the right of the prompt footer.
